2026-10-30.subject: Daily Status Report - 30-10-2026
2026-10-30.raw_body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

--

2026-11-03.subject: Daily Work Update - 03-11-2026
2026-11-03.cc: PRAJWAL D A <prajwal.da@nsoft.in>, Sumukh Hegde <sumukh.hegde@nsoft.in>, Dharmaraj B <dharmaraj.b@nsoft.in>
2026-11-03.raw_body:
Hi Sir,

Please find below my work update.

------------------------------------------------------------
(03-11-2026) - Work Done
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Salary Arrears Report (HRMSalaryArrearsReport)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024 in the Year dropdown (earlier only 2025 and
2026).

2. Salary Arrears JV (HRMSalaryArrearsJV)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024.
   - Changed design: Employee Name selection moved to the top.
   - On selecting the employee, Year, From Month and To Month are
auto-filled.
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected based on the login user.

3. ELS Approval (HRMELSApproval)
   - Applied the new screen design in the main ERP source.
   - Fixed Net Pay calculation: at the next approval level, Net Pay was
showing
     the month-wise total without subtracting the deduction, and changing
the
     deduction twice was subtracting it twice.
     Now Net Pay = Month-wise Total - All Deductions.
   - Deduction amount can be edited at one level; after it is saved, the
next
     levels see it as read-only.

4. Salary Fund Request (HRMSalaryFundRequestNew)
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected.
   - Added BR No (mandatory) and BR Date (today's date only, past and
future dates are locked).
   - BR No and BR Date are saved in the existing table B_BRNO (MBRNO,
MBRDate).

5. Salary Fund Request Approval (HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval)
   - Showing BR No and BR Date of the bill.
   - JV grid now shows only Account Head, Debit and Credit.
   - Added a new Budget grid: Already Allocated, Used and Available amount.
   - SQL updated: USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval

6. Checked why the AAO login was not seeing the fund request in approval.
   Found it depends on the login office and the user's role order. Not a
code issue.

------------------------------------------------------------
(04-11-2026) - Work in Progress
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Working on Salary JV in HRMS.
   - Checking the JV creation flow (Debit / Credit account heads, totals).
   - Checking the approval flow for the JV.
   - Testing on the dev server.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I LEARNED
------------------------------------------------------------

1. How the approval flow works using M_ApprovalManagement (ScreenId, RoleId,
   RoleOrderId). A bill shows to the next user only when that user's role
   order is the next one in the flow and the office matches.
2. How the revenue budget is calculated:
   Available = Allocated - Used (Used = approved bills of the financial
year).
3. Net Pay should always be calculated from the totals
   (Total - Deductions), not from the previous Net Pay value on the screen.
   Otherwise the value becomes wrong when the amount is changed again.
4. BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to
the
   bill through B_BillPassing.BRID.
5. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before
changing,
   and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first.
6. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some
screens and
   procedures can be different between the servers.

------------------------------------------------------------
FILES FOR DEPLOYMENT (03-11-2026)
------------------------------------------------------------
ERP Files:
   - HRMSalaryArrearsReport.aspx
   - HRMSalaryArrearsJV.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMELSApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestNew.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
SQL:
   - USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval.sql

Thanks & Regards,
Venkata Sai

--

curr_cell.raw_body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

prev_cell.subject: Daily Status Report - 30-10-2026
prev_cell.raw_body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

Dear Sumukh Sir,

Please find my update for today below.

What I did today:
- Verified the EmployeeCreationApproval screen to make sure the Aadhar card
and PAN card documents are displayed correctly.
- We changed the backend logic to read from the
HRMS_AdditionalDocumnetsAppr table, in which the file paths are already
saved on the live server. I tested that the documents now load properly
from these saved paths.

What I learnt:
- How the backend picks up document file paths from the
HRMS_AdditionalDocumnetsAppr table instead of the earlier logic, and how
those stored paths map to the files on the live server.
- The importance of validating that the saved file paths on the live server
resolve correctly so that documents display on the approval screen.

What I will do tomorrow:
- Deployment of the Employee modules.

Thanks & Regards,
Lasya.

Hi Sir,

Please find below my work update.

------------------------------------------------------------
(03-11-2026) - Work Done
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Salary Arrears Report (HRMSalaryArrearsReport)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024 in the Year dropdown (earlier only 2025 and
2026).

2. Salary Arrears JV (HRMSalaryArrearsJV)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024.
   - Changed design: Employee Name selection moved to the top.
   - On selecting the employee, Year, From Month and To Month are
auto-filled.
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected based on the login user.

3. ELS Approval (HRMELSApproval)
   - Applied the new screen design in the main ERP source.
   - Fixed Net Pay calculation: at the next approval level, Net Pay was
showing
     the month-wise total without subtracting the deduction, and changing
the
     deduction twice was subtracting it twice.
     Now Net Pay = Month-wise Total - All Deductions.
   - Deduction amount can be edited at one level; after it is saved, the
next
     levels see it as read-only.

4. Salary Fund Request (HRMSalaryFundRequestNew)
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected.
   - Added BR No (mandatory) and BR Date (today's date only, past and
future dates are locked).
   - BR No and BR Date are saved in the existing table B_BRNO (MBRNO,
MBRDate).

5. Salary Fund Request Approval (HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval)
   - Showing BR No and BR Date of the bill.
   - JV grid now shows only Account Head, Debit and Credit.
   - Added a new Budget grid: Already Allocated, Used and Available amount.
   - SQL updated: USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval

6. Checked why the AAO login was not seeing the fund request in approval.
   Found it depends on the login office and the user's role order. Not a
code issue.

------------------------------------------------------------
(04-11-2026) - Work in Progress
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Working on Salary JV in HRMS.
   - Checking the JV creation flow (Debit / Credit account heads, totals).
   - Checking the approval flow for the JV.
   - Testing on the dev server.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I LEARNED
------------------------------------------------------------

1. How the approval flow works using M_ApprovalManagement (ScreenId, RoleId,
   RoleOrderId). A bill shows to the next user only when that user's role
   order is the next one in the flow and the office matches.
2. How the revenue budget is calculated:
   Available = Allocated - Used (Used = approved bills of the financial
year).
3. Net Pay should always be calculated from the totals
   (Total - Deductions), not from the previous Net Pay value on the screen.
   Otherwise the value becomes wrong when the amount is changed again.
4. BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to
the
   bill through B_BillPassing.BRID.
5. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before
changing,
   and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first.
6. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some
screens and
   procedures can be different between the servers.

------------------------------------------------------------
FILES FOR DEPLOYMENT (03-11-2026)
------------------------------------------------------------
ERP Files:
   - HRMSalaryArrearsReport.aspx
   - HRMSalaryArrearsJV.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMELSApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestNew.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
SQL:
   - USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval.sql

Thanks & Regards,
Venkata Sai

prev_cell.raw_body:
Hi Sir,

Please find below my work update.

------------------------------------------------------------
(03-11-2026) - Work Done
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Salary Arrears Report (HRMSalaryArrearsReport)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024 in the Year dropdown (earlier only 2025 and
2026).

2. Salary Arrears JV (HRMSalaryArrearsJV)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024.
   - Changed design: Employee Name selection moved to the top.
   - On selecting the employee, Year, From Month and To Month are
auto-filled.
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected based on the login user.

3. ELS Approval (HRMELSApproval)
   - Applied the new screen design in the main ERP source.
   - Fixed Net Pay calculation: at the next approval level, Net Pay was
showing
     the month-wise total without subtracting the deduction, and changing
the
     deduction twice was subtracting it twice.
     Now Net Pay = Month-wise Total - All Deductions.
   - Deduction amount can be edited at one level; after it is saved, the
next
     levels see it as read-only.

4. Salary Fund Request (HRMSalaryFundRequestNew)
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected.
   - Added BR No (mandatory) and BR Date (today's date only, past and
future dates are locked).
   - BR No and BR Date are saved in the existing table B_BRNO (MBRNO,
MBRDate).

5. Salary Fund Request Approval (HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval)
   - Showing BR No and BR Date of the bill.
   - JV grid now shows only Account Head, Debit and Credit.
   - Added a new Budget grid: Already Allocated, Used and Available amount.
   - SQL updated: USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval

6. Checked why the AAO login was not seeing the fund request in approval.
   Found it depends on the login office and the user's role order. Not a
code issue.

------------------------------------------------------------
(04-11-2026) - Work in Progress
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Working on Salary JV in HRMS.
   - Checking the JV creation flow (Debit / Credit account heads, totals).
   - Checking the approval flow for the JV.
   - Testing on the dev server.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I LEARNED
------------------------------------------------------------

1. How the approval flow works using M_ApprovalManagement (ScreenId, RoleId,
   RoleOrderId). A bill shows to the next user only when that user's role
   order is the next one in the flow and the office matches.
2. How the revenue budget is calculated:
   Available = Allocated - Used (Used = approved bills of the financial
year).
3. Net Pay should always be calculated from the totals
   (Total - Deductions), not from the previous Net Pay value on the screen.
   Otherwise the value becomes wrong when the amount is changed again.
4. BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to
the
   bill through B_BillPassing.BRID.
5. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before
changing,
   and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first.
6. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some
screens and
   procedures can be different between the servers.

------------------------------------------------------------
FILES FOR DEPLOYMENT (03-11-2026)
------------------------------------------------------------
ERP Files:
   - HRMSalaryArrearsReport.aspx
   - HRMSalaryArrearsJV.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMELSApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestNew.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
SQL:
   - USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval.sql

Thanks & Regards,
Venkata Sai

source_cell.raw_body:
Hi Sir,

Please find below my work update.

------------------------------------------------------------
(03-11-2026) - Work Done
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Salary Arrears Report (HRMSalaryArrearsReport)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024 in the Year dropdown (earlier only 2025 and
2026).

2. Salary Arrears JV (HRMSalaryArrearsJV)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024.
   - Changed design: Employee Name selection moved to the top.
   - On selecting the employee, Year, From Month and To Month are
auto-filled.
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected based on the login user.

3. ELS Approval (HRMELSApproval)
   - Applied the new screen design in the main ERP source.
   - Fixed Net Pay calculation: at the next approval level, Net Pay was
showing
     the month-wise total without subtracting the deduction, and changing
the
     deduction twice was subtracting it twice.
     Now Net Pay = Month-wise Total - All Deductions.
   - Deduction amount can be edited at one level; after it is saved, the
next
     levels see it as read-only.

4. Salary Fund Request (HRMSalaryFundRequestNew)
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected.
   - Added BR No (mandatory) and BR Date (today's date only, past and
future dates are locked).
   - BR No and BR Date are saved in the existing table B_BRNO (MBRNO,
MBRDate).

5. Salary Fund Request Approval (HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval)
   - Showing BR No and BR Date of the bill.
   - JV grid now shows only Account Head, Debit and Credit.
   - Added a new Budget grid: Already Allocated, Used and Available amount.
   - SQL updated: USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval

6. Checked why the AAO login was not seeing the fund request in approval.
   Found it depends on the login office and the user's role order. Not a
code issue.

------------------------------------------------------------
(04-11-2026) - Work in Progress
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Working on Salary JV in HRMS.
   - Checking the JV creation flow (Debit / Credit account heads, totals).
   - Checking the approval flow for the JV.
   - Testing on the dev server.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I LEARNED
------------------------------------------------------------

1. How the approval flow works using M_ApprovalManagement (ScreenId, RoleId,
   RoleOrderId). A bill shows to the next user only when that user's role
   order is the next one in the flow and the office matches.
2. How the revenue budget is calculated:
   Available = Allocated - Used (Used = approved bills of the financial
year).
3. Net Pay should always be calculated from the totals
   (Total - Deductions), not from the previous Net Pay value on the screen.
   Otherwise the value becomes wrong when the amount is changed again.
4. BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to
the
   bill through B_BillPassing.BRID.
5. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before
changing,
   and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first.
6. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some
screens and
   procedures can be different between the servers.

------------------------------------------------------------
FILES FOR DEPLOYMENT (03-11-2026)
------------------------------------------------------------
ERP Files:
   - HRMSalaryArrearsReport.aspx
   - HRMSalaryArrearsJV.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMELSApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestNew.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
SQL:
   - USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval.sql

Thanks & Regards,
Venkata Sai

BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to the bill through B_BillPassing.BRID. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before changing, and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some screens and procedures can be different between the servers.

Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

source_cell.raw_body:
Hi Sir,

Please find below my work update.

------------------------------------------------------------
(03-11-2026) - Work Done
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Salary Arrears Report (HRMSalaryArrearsReport)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024 in the Year dropdown (earlier only 2025 and
2026).

2. Salary Arrears JV (HRMSalaryArrearsJV)
   - Added years 2023 and 2024.
   - Changed design: Employee Name selection moved to the top.
   - On selecting the employee, Year, From Month and To Month are
auto-filled.
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected based on the login user.

3. ELS Approval (HRMELSApproval)
   - Applied the new screen design in the main ERP source.
   - Fixed Net Pay calculation: at the next approval level, Net Pay was
showing
     the month-wise total without subtracting the deduction, and changing
the
     deduction twice was subtracting it twice.
     Now Net Pay = Month-wise Total - All Deductions.
   - Deduction amount can be edited at one level; after it is saved, the
next
     levels see it as read-only.

4. Salary Fund Request (HRMSalaryFundRequestNew)
   - Org Level and Office are auto-selected.
   - Added BR No (mandatory) and BR Date (today's date only, past and
future dates are locked).
   - BR No and BR Date are saved in the existing table B_BRNO (MBRNO,
MBRDate).

5. Salary Fund Request Approval (HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval)
   - Showing BR No and BR Date of the bill.
   - JV grid now shows only Account Head, Debit and Credit.
   - Added a new Budget grid: Already Allocated, Used and Available amount.
   - SQL updated: USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval

6. Checked why the AAO login was not seeing the fund request in approval.
   Found it depends on the login office and the user's role order. Not a
code issue.

------------------------------------------------------------
(04-11-2026) - Work in Progress
------------------------------------------------------------

1. Working on Salary JV in HRMS.
   - Checking the JV creation flow (Debit / Credit account heads, totals).
   - Checking the approval flow for the JV.
   - Testing on the dev server.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I LEARNED
------------------------------------------------------------

1. How the approval flow works using M_ApprovalManagement (ScreenId, RoleId,
   RoleOrderId). A bill shows to the next user only when that user's role
   order is the next one in the flow and the office matches.
2. How the revenue budget is calculated:
   Available = Allocated - Used (Used = approved bills of the financial
year).
3. Net Pay should always be calculated from the totals
   (Total - Deductions), not from the previous Net Pay value on the screen.
   Otherwise the value becomes wrong when the amount is changed again.
4. BR No / BR Date for the fund request are stored in B_BRNO and linked to
the
   bill through B_BillPassing.BRID.
5. Always take a backup of the file and the stored procedure before
changing,
   and test SQL changes inside BEGIN TRAN ... ROLLBACK on dev first.
6. Before deploying, compare the dev and live versions, because some
screens and
   procedures can be different between the servers.

------------------------------------------------------------
FILES FOR DEPLOYMENT (03-11-2026)
------------------------------------------------------------
ERP Files:
   - HRMSalaryArrearsReport.aspx
   - HRMSalaryArrearsJV.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMELSApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestNew.aspx / .aspx.cs
   - HRMSalaryFundRequestApproval.aspx / .aspx.cs
SQL:
   - USP_HRMS_SalaryFundRequestApproval.sql

Thanks & Regards,
Venkata Sai

2026-10-30.subject: Daily Status Report - 30-10-2026
2026-10-30.raw_body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find below my work status for today.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TODAY'S WORK (30-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. HRM Salary Arrears screen (GESCOM ERP and Employee Portal)
   a) Existing Basic is now editable in the arrears grid. When it is
      changed, Basic Difference, DP, DA, HRA, CPS 14%/10%, Total,
      Deductions and Net Payable are recalculated immediately, along
      with the employee subtotals and grand total.
   b) Existing Basic and Revised Basic can be entered and updated for
      any year, including months that are already Recommended or
      Approved. The edited values are saved through
      USP_HRMSalaryArrears.
   c) DA % is now taken from DAEffectiveDateCapture in the same way as
      the DA Effective Date Capture screen. Each month uses the entry
      for that month, or the last entry before it if the month has no
      entry of its own.
   d) DP rule applied: DP is 0 for 2023 and for Jan-2024 to Jul-2024.
      From Aug-2024 onwards DP is 31% of the Basic Difference.
   e) All the above changes were made in both the GESCOM ERP source
      and the Employee Portal source.

2. Employee Salary Bill Approval screen (GESCOM ERP)
   a) Redesigned the screen to be more user friendly, in four clear
      sections: Pending Bills, Salary Period, Earnings and Deductions,
      and Certification and Approval.
   b) Added a search box, a highlighted selected bill, side-by-side
      Earnings and Deductions with totals, and a Gross / Deduction /
      Net Pay summary. The Approve and Return buttons are now
      different colours so they are easy to tell apart.
   c) The approval logic is unchanged. Only the design was changed.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
TOMORROW'S PLAN (31-10-2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Work on the Salary Fund Request Budget screen.
2. Test the Salary Arrears changes (Existing Basic edit, DA %, DP
   rule) end to end in both ERP and Employee Portal, and check that
   the stored procedure saves and returns the edited Existing Basic.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
LEARNINGS FROM TODAY
-----------------------------------------------------------------


1. When the same screen exists in two projects (ERP and Employee
   Portal), the changes should be applied carefully to each file
   rather than copying the whole file, because each project has its
   own differences.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

Regards,
Venkata Sai

--

sync_owners.name: Kousalya Talari

sync_owners.focus: Monitors daily smart-meter test closure (sent Oct 31 11:24 PM status reminder, prompting Kousalya's Nov 1 7:03 AM update).

sync_owners.focus: Coordinate post-billing PR XML schema, API endpoints, and DLMS meter firmware/TCP response troubleshooting.

sync_owners.name: Prasad Amara
sync_owners.focus: Drives reliable multi-vendor (INESH, Capital, CMRL) prepaid metering rollouts with zero duplicate deductions.

outcome_iterations.track: INESH Prepaid Billing Engine, Relay Switch & Post-Billing PR XML/API
outcome_iterations.v1_reported: Tested INESH prepaid billing, daily charge deduction, missed-day recovery, DLMS relay status, and post-billing PR XML/API integration.
outcome_iterations.v2_owner_sync: Guarantee idempotent daily charge deduction (zero duplicate deductions on retry), deterministic missed-day catch-up, and verified DLMS load-switch disconnect/reconnect on zero/positive balance.
outcome_iterations.v3_business_outcome: Production-grade INESH prepaid billing loop with automated daily deduction, missed-day recovery, physical relay disconnect/reconnect, and real-time PR XML sync.

outcome_iterations.track: Capital Meter DLMS Communication & Cumulative Energy Consumption
outcome_iterations.v1_reported: Analysed TCP response errors, worked on Capital meter DLMS communication, cumulative energy register readings, and daily consumption calculation.
outcome_iterations.v2_owner_sync: Isolate TCP timeout/framing errors on Capital meters and validate daily kWh consumption delta calculation across midnight register rollovers.
outcome_iterations.v3_business_outcome: Multi-vendor prepaid metering support across both INESH and Capital DLMS meters with accurate daily kWh consumption and balance deduction.

business_alignment.strategic_summary: Anchors NSoft's Smart Metering & Prepaid Billing capability across INESH, Capital, and CMRL meters—directly preventing utility revenue leakage and enabling automated load control.

value_chains.deliverable: INESH Prepaid Deduction, Missed-Day Recovery & PR XML API
value_chains.artifact: INESH Prepaid Engine, DLMS Relay OBIS Attributes, PR XML Generator
value_chains.business_impact: Prevents duplicate daily deductions while recovering charges for offline/missed days and syncing post-billing PR XML via API.
value_chains.kpi: Zero duplicate deductions + verified DLMS relay switch state

value_chains.deliverable: Capital Meter DLMS Cumulative Register & TCP Error Resolution
value_chains.artifact: Capital Meter DLMS Reader & Daily Consumption Calculator
value_chains.business_impact: Extends prepaid billing to Capital meters by computing daily consumption from cumulative energy registers.
value_chains.kpi: 6/6 days reported with 6/6 Green domain learnings

ai_agent_usage.current_stage: L1.5: Manual Hardware/DLMS Protocol Testing & Log Inspection
ai_agent_usage.target_stage: L3: AI-Powered DLMS Packet Decoder & Prepaid State-Machine Simulator
ai_agent_usage.observation: Kousalya has spent 6 consecutive days testing complex stateful prepaid billing scenarios (missed-day recovery, duplicate deduction, TCP response errors, cumulative register deltas). An AI agent that simulates multi-day meter register sequences will cut manual test cycles in half.

playbooks.title: Prepaid Billing Multi-Day Edge-Case Simulator Agent
playbooks.context: When testing daily charge deduction, missed-day recovery, and duplicate deduction prevention.
playbooks.prompt: Generate a table-driven test suite for our prepaid billing deduction service covering: (1) normal daily deduction, (2) 3 missed offline days followed by reconnection recovery, (3) duplicate scheduler trigger on the same calendar day (idempotency check), and (4) balance crossing 0 triggering DLMS relay disconnect.

playbooks.title: DLMS TCP Response & OBIS Register Diagnostic Agent
playbooks.context: When troubleshooting Capital/INESH meter TCP response errors and cumulative energy register readings.
playbooks.prompt: Here is our DLMS TCP communication log and OBIS code read sequence for the Capital meter cumulative energy register. Identify why TCP response timeouts/errors occur on consecutive frame reads and suggest retry/backoff + register scaling validation logic.

dimension_notes.technical_depth: Strong protocol-level work across DLMS attributes, TCP socket responses, PR XML payloads, and energy register delta math.
dimension_notes.domain_mastery: Deep domain fluency in prepaid utility billing cycles, load switch disconnect/reconnect thresholds, and missed-day recovery.
dimension_notes.engineering_craft: Systematically tests both happy path and failure recovery (missed days, duplicate deduction, TCP errors).
dimension_notes.communication_ownership: 6/6 days reported (including Sun 7:03 AM catch-up after Sumukh's nudge), but sent Nov 4 email with a blank Subject line and kept several multi-day bullets high-level.

reflection_upgrades.original: Learned more about DLMS meter communication and prepaid billing implementation.
reflection_upgrades.upgraded: Diagnosed that Capital meter TCP response errors occurred when polling cumulative energy OBIS registers without waiting for the previous association frame to close; added frame timeout handling before computing daily consumption deltas.

growth_goals: Always include a clear email Subject line (`Daily Work Report – DD Nov 2026`) — Nov 4 subject was blank.
Break multi-day carryover items ('Continue prepaid billing implementation') into specific daily pass/fail test metrics.
Use an AI agent to build an automated simulator for 7-day prepaid deduction & missed-day recovery.
